Big Things Happening!

We're transforming one of our historic barns into our new farm store, a place where friends, families, and our community can experience everything Sweet Grass Dairy has to offer.

​

By preserving the character of the original barn while giving it new life, we're creating a welcoming space to shop our grass-fed beef, forest-raised pork, farm-fresh dairy products, seasonal goods, and more.

​

Every board, beam, and detail is being thoughtfully restored to honor the history of our farm while building something for generations to come.

​

We can't wait to open the doors and welcome you to the next chapter of Sweet Grass Dairy. Stay tuned as the transformation continues!

The Heart of Sweet Grass Dairy

We’re a family-owned farm committed to raising happy, healthy animals on lush Ohio pastures. By controlling every step—from pasture to plate—we ensure the highest quality dairy and meats for your family.

100% Grass-fed & Grass-finished

Our Beef is rotated across organically managed pastures utilizing regenerative grazing practices.

No GMOs

We use feed grown with organic practices. Our animal feeds are grown by a partner farmer. Our animal feed is grown within 10 miles of our home farm. 

No Antibiotics

Raising animals the way nature intended removes the risk for disease and infections.

Common Questions
Can I recycle my packaging?

All of the cardboard and insulation material is biodegradable! So feel free to compost or drop at a paper recycling drop point. If you live near the farm, we can reuse clean shipping material :) We will pick up clean shipping material at the time of the next delivery.

When will my card be charged?

Because many items are charged by the pound we will not know your exact total until order is packed at which time your card will be charged.

Who will deliver my order?

Local deliveries are usually delivered by Farmer Jake. Fed-Ex delivers non local orders.

What are the shipping cost?

Shipping cost will vary depending on your location. Delivery fees are calculated at checkout. There is a $75 order minimum for home delivery.

When will my order be delivered?

We deliver orders on an every other week basis. Local orders are delivered Tuesday. Fed-Ex order may arrive Thursday-Saturday of the same week.

What if I'm not home?

No problem. We'll leave your order at the front door in an insulated box. Once you do arrive home we just ask that you would unpack your items as soon as you are able.

How should I expect my order to arrive?

Items are carefully packaged in a refrigerated box so food stays fresh even if you’re not home when we deliver. Any freshly thawed items can either be refrigerated or refroze for later use.

Our Food Promise

We want to raise the best food possible for our family and your family!

Protocols
100% Grass-fed & Grass-finished

Our Beef is rotated across organically managed pastures utilizing regenerative grazing practices.

Shop Now
Made with Animal Rennet

Our cheeses are made with traditional animal rennet. Most "plant" based rennets are actually a GMO product. Our cheese is made in small artisanal batches using historical practices.

Shop Now
No GMOs

We use feed grown with organic practices. Our animal feeds are grown by a partner farmer. Our animal feed is grown within 10 miles of our home farm. We know exactly how and where it is grown.

Shop Now
No need for Antibitotics

Raising animals the way nature intended removes the risk for disease and infections. We have no need for antibiotics when we work harmoniously with nature.

Shop Now
No Vaccines and definitely not mRNA vaccines

We raise our animals with care and harness the symbiosis of nature to create healthy environments for our animals.

Shop Now
Regenerative Farming

Nature can rebuild itself into a thriving community of millions of species. Our animals graze harmoniously with their natural environment. We are able to harvest carbon and nitrogen from the atmosphere and we create a net negative carbon impact through this natural process.

Shop Now
Humanely Raised

Organically Pasture Raised

No GMOs

No Need for Antibiotics

Regenerative Grazing

Sunshine, Fresh Air, & Love

Testimonials
 Jacob and his wife are very sweet, gentle and informed people. Their knowledge of sustainable organic farming and nutrition is astounding! My husband and I took Jacob's tour of the farm and we were completely impressed with concepts and ideas he is using to run a farm completely without chemicals and hormones! We joined the cow-share right there on the spot and we have never regretted it! The milk is absolutely delicious and so nutritious! We have not experienced any adverse effects or illness like some bureaucracies would like you to think. You need to experience this farm to see for yourself. We will never go back to pasteurized milk ever again. 
Christine (Mt. Gilead, OH)
 Our source for milk, eggs and chicken. Organic, thoughtful producers, Jacob and Elizabeth are a huge resource for the area providing excellent quality products. 
Don (Fredericktown, OH)
 I can feel good about everything I purchase here because I know this family is intent on farming the right way, where everyone wins. 
Sally (Columbus, OH)
